Hi Elena — thanks for sending this over and for the tight timeline. Quick recap from our call and next steps:

Recap & answers (high level):
- SOC 2: Redwood Inference is currently undergoing SOC 2 Type II; testing period completed March 1, 2027 and final report targeted for delivery end of Q2 2027 (we can provide an interim SOC 2 summary which covers controls and scope). See attached soc2 summary.
- Subprocessors: attached CSV (redwood-subprocessors-20270316.csv) lists primary subprocessors and purposes. Top-level: AWS (hosting, us-east-1), GCP (cross-region backups), Datadog (monitoring/observability), Sentry (error reporting, if enabled by customer), Postgres hoster (managed DB for control plane metadata). We do not share customer content with marketing/advertising vendors.
- Data sharing boundaries: Customer content (prompts + responses) is processed in isolated inference clusters; we don’t use customer content to train models, and we do not sell or share raw customer content with third parties. Logs/metrics sent to observability vendors are redacted/aggregated by default — PII is not forwarded except when explicitly asked by the customer for debugging under signed agreements.
- GDPR/HIPAA: We support data residency controls for Dedicated and Private deployments. For hosted customers, we offer region selection (US / EU). We can sign a HIPAA BAA for covered workloads — we’ve done several BAAs with enterprise customers.

Proposed next steps:
1) I’m attaching the CSV and a soc2 summary PDF for your initial review.
2) Logan (cc’d) will follow up with a short technical note on encryption and KMS.
3) Can we schedule a 30m evidence call — suggested times:
   - Thu 2027-03-18 09:00–12:00 PT
   - Fri 2027-03-19 08:30–11:00 PT

If you need the actual SOC 2 report earlier, we can provide an auditor-certified SOC 2 interim letter and a higher-level control map while the final report is finalized.

Thanks — attaching files now.

Hi Elena — quick technical follow-up to supplement Marissa's note.

Encryption & keys:
- In transit: TLS 1.2+ for all client <-> Redwood endpoints.
- At rest: customer data stored encrypted using AES-256. For hosted customers we offer customer-managed keys via KMS integrations (AWS KMS / GCP KMS) for the control plane metadata where requested.

Subprocessors (technical details):
- AWS (Amazon Web Services) — primary inference hosts and object storage (us-east-1).
- GCP (Google Cloud) — cross-region backups and analytics bucket for aggregated metrics (encrypted).
- Datadog — metrics and traces (sampling and redaction applied by default).
- Sentry — optional error/stack traces when customers enable advanced debugging.
- Snowflake (partner analytics) — for anonymized, aggregated product telemetry (only if customer opts in).

Data residency & transfer:
- For hosted customers, you can request EU-only processing for your org; Dedicated and Private deployments keep data strictly in the customer VPC/region.
- We do not transfer customer content to subprocessors for model training.

Evidence & timelines:
- Interim SOC 2 summary attached; full Type II report expected by 2027-06-30. We can provide auditor contact under NDA if required.
- For procurement: we can provide the DPA and start DocuSign flow once procurement confirms scope.

Happy to jump on a 30m call to walk through any of the above.
—Logan
